item.title: Welcome Jill and Dj!
item.description:
COSINE LAB is excited to announce that Jill and Dj have officially joined us as Cosiners.

Bringing fresh perspectives and energy, both Jill and Dj will be vital to expanding our research initiatives and shaping a collaborative, innovative environment in the lab. We are genuinely thrilled to support them in their academic journeys and can’t wait to see the impactful work they will do here.

Welcome to the team, Jill and Dj!

item.title: Welcome Ji!
item.description:
COSINE LAB is excited to announce that Ji has officially joined us as our very first Cosiner.

As the inaugural member of the team, Ji will be instrumental in launching our research initiatives and shaping the lab’s collaborative culture. We are thrilled to have his talent and energy on board as we begin this journey.

Welcome to the lab, Ji!
